fusions.name: Hauled Up Short
fusions.desc: Casts a loop over the first enemy it meets and pulls it up short. It deals 12 damage and stuns the target for 1.4 seconds. Its damage rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone (max 40%).

fusions.name: Deadweight Maul
fusions.desc: Brings a maul down that deals 30 damage, plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health. It leaves the target [Pinned] for 3 seconds and 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Wintering Cocoon
fusions.desc: Spins a cocoon around you that restores 4 health a second to you for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Stakebound Cub
fusions.desc: A bonded cub on a tether swats enemies within 3 tiles for 7 damage every 2.4 seconds.
